shared Dim_Date = let
    MinDate = #date( 2026, 1, 1 ),
    MaxDate = #date( 2026, 12, 31 ),
    DayCount = Duration.Days( MaxDate - MinDate ) + 1,
    DateList = List.Dates( MinDate, DayCount, #duration( 1, 0, 0, 0 ) ),
    AsTable = Table.FromList( DateList, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"Date"} ),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes( AsTable, {{"Date", type date}} ),
    WithYear = Table.AddColumn( Typed, "Year", each Date.Year( [Date] ), Int64.Type ),
    WithQuarter = Table.AddColumn( WithYear, "Quarter", each "Q" & Text.From( Date.QuarterOfYear( [Date] ) ), type text ),
    WithMonthNo = Table.AddColumn( WithQuarter, "MonthNumber", each Date.Month( [Date] ), Int64.Type ),
    WithMonthName = Table.AddColumn( WithMonthNo, "MonthName", each Date.ToText( [Date], "MMM" ), type text ),
    WithYearMonth = Table.AddColumn( WithMonthName, "YearMonth", each Date.Year( [Date] ) * 100 + Date.Month( [Date] ), Int64.Type ),
    WithMonthEnd = Table.AddColumn( WithYearMonth, "IsMonthEnd", each [Date] = Date.EndOfMonth( [Date] ), type logical )
in
    WithMonthEnd;
